term.label: sense_overlap_lncRNA

definition.text: A long non-coding transcript that contains a protein coding gene within its intronic sequence on the same strand, with no overlap of exonic sequence.

comments: Updating the names of sense_intronic_ncRNA (SO:0002131), sense_overlap_ncRNA (SO:0002132), sense_overlap_ncRNA_gene (SO:0002183), and sense_intronic_ncRNA_gene (SO:0002184) to _lncRNA. See GitHub Issue #579.
